Payment: PayNow to UEN 202012345K or transfer to DBS business account 012-345678-9, quoting INV-2026-0481.

DBS business account 012-345678-9 — transaction history export (SGD)
Transaction Date,Reference,Debit Amount,Credit Amount,Transaction Ref1,Transaction Ref2,Transaction Ref3
10 Sep 2026,ICT,,1900.00,PAYNOW TRANSFER,LIM FAMILY DENTAL PTE LTD,INV-2026-0481

From: clinic@limfamilydental.example
Date: 10 Sep 2026
Subject: Overpayment on INV-2026-0481

Sorry — our PayNow transfer today for INV-2026-0481 went out as S$1,900.00 instead of S$1,090.00 (typo). Please apply S$1,090.00 to the invoice and refund the S$810.00 difference to our PayNow UEN.

Work request: investigate whether the invoice identified in this packet has been settled as of the snapshot date. The request itself is not evidence that any payment occurred or that anyone owes a reply.
